responsibility: Implements an AST-to-AST desugaring pass that rewrites Rust `for` loop expressions into explicit iterator machinery before later frontend stages. Using `AST::Builder` and lang-item paths, it expands `for <pat> in <expr> { ... }` into a block containing `IntoIterator::into_iter`, a `loop`, `Iterator::next`, `Option::{Some,None}` matching, temporary bindings for the iterator and next value, and the original body, mutating expression subtrees in place as it visits block statements and tail expressions; this file therefore owns the concrete lowering shape of `for` syntax at the AST level.
same_name_distinction: Implements the actual `for`-loop expansion by building the replacement iterator/match/loop AST, helper match cases, and in-place expression replacement while visiting blocks. Unlike the paired header, this `.cc` file owns the concrete generated AST shape and mutation logic for rewriting `ForLoopExpr` nodes.
